# UNICEF Data Analysis Report

## Introduction

This report presents a data-driven narrative using UNICEF's global indicators to raise awareness on two critical issues affecting children and youth: **AIDS-related deaths among adolescents** and **access to improved drinking water in schools**. Visualizations and analysis are based on UNICEF-provided datasets and World Bank metadata, created using Python and Plotnine.

---

## Data Preparation

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import plotnine as p9
import geopandas as gpd

# Load datasets
indicator1 = pd.read_csv("unicef_indicator_1.csv")
indicator2 = pd.read_csv("unicef_indicator_2.csv")
metadata = pd.read_csv("unicef_metadata.csv")
```

---

## 1. World Map – Drinking Water Access in Schools

```{python}
# Filter for recent data
latest_year = indicator2['time_period'].max()
df_map = indicator2[indicator2['time_period'] == latest_year]

# Merge with world geodata
world = gpd.read_file(gpd.datasets.get_path('naturalearth_lowres'))
world = world.rename(columns={"name": "country"})
merged = world.merge(df_map, on="country")

# Plot
(
    p9.ggplot(merged.dropna(), p9.aes(fill='obs_value')) +
    p9.geom_map(map_id='country', data=merged.dropna(), map=merged.dropna()) +
    p9.labs(title='Drinking Water Access in Schools (Latest Year)', fill='% Access') +
    p9.theme_minimal()
)
```

---

## 2. Bar Chart – AIDS-related Death Rate (Top 10 Countries)

```{python}
bar_data = indicator1[indicator1['time_period'] == 2015].copy()
bar_data['obs_value'] = pd.to_numeric(bar_data['obs_value'], errors='coerce')
bar_data = bar_data.sort_values('obs_value', ascending=False).head(10)

(
    p9.ggplot(bar_data, p9.aes(x='reorder(country, obs_value)', y='obs_value')) +
    p9.geom_col(fill='crimson') +
    p9.coord_flip() +
    p9.labs(title='Top 10 Countries by AIDS-related Deaths (2015)', y='Death Rate', x='Country') +
    p9.theme_minimal()
)
```

---

## 3. Scatter Plot – Water Access vs Life Expectancy

```{python}
combined = indicator2[indicator2['time_period'] == 2015].merge(
    metadata[metadata['year'] == 2015], on='country')

(
    p9.ggplot(combined, p9.aes(x='obs_value', y='Life expectancy at birth, total (years)')) +
    p9.geom_point() +
    p9.geom_smooth(method='lm', color='blue') +
    p9.labs(title='Water Access vs Life Expectancy', x='% Water Access in Schools', y='Life Expectancy') +
    p9.theme_light()
)
```

---

## 4. Time-Series Line Chart – AIDS Death Rate Trends

```{python}
selected = indicator1[indicator1['country'].isin(['India', 'Nigeria', 'Brazil'])].copy()
selected['obs_value'] = pd.to_numeric(selected['obs_value'], errors='coerce')

(
    p9.ggplot(selected, p9.aes(x='time_period', y='obs_value', color='country')) +
    p9.geom_line() +
    p9.labs(title='AIDS Death Rates Over Time (10–19 years)', x='Year', y='Death Rate') +
    p9.theme_minimal()
)
```

---

## Conclusion

The charts demonstrate strong inequalities in both health and infrastructure. Sub-Saharan African countries report higher AIDS-related death rates among adolescents, while many regions still lack access to clean water in schools. These challenges are interconnected and demand attention from global policymakers.
